other_conditions: The unit must be a new unit that commences production on or after 2-8-2004 and will be eligible for the incentive for 5 years from the date of commencement of production.
The unit must provide direct employment to at least 10 persons.
At least 60% of the employment created by the unit must be to people of the UT of Puducherry.

For new units, the application must be submitted within one year from the date of obtaining the Entrepreneurs Memorandum Part‑2/ Permanent Registration/ Commencement of Production Certificate; for existing units, within one year of completion of expansion/diversification/modernization.
benefits_summary: Provides a wage/employment subsidy of 20% of salary up to ₹5,00,000 per annum for workers covered under the Provident Fund, subject to the unit meeting specific employment criteria.
documents_required: Prescribed application form (available on the Official Website of the Directorate of Industries and Commerce, Puducherry)
Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
